basic_info.description: Located in Cow Hollow, one of the city's most coveted neighborhoods, 32 Harris Street is a sun-drenched top-floor Victorian flat that seamlessly marries timeless craftsmanship with modern refinement. This reimagined residence features soaring ceilings, large principal rooms and an intuitive floor plan designed for elevated city living. The family room is built around custom cabinetry that discretely houses the television and is flooded with natural light through the oversized south and east facing windows. The dining area is anchored by the custom seating and overlooks the elegant chef's kitchen. The sophisticated and polished kitchen features bespoke cabinetry, stone countertops and premium appliances. The graciously scaled bedroom features three closets, room for a king bed and a bonus office or den, separated by glass doors. The bathroom has a timeless and spa like feel.The shared backyard benefits from the northside sun; and is perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Moments from the boutiques and cafes of Union and Fillmore Streets, yet tucked into a tranquil enclave, 32 Harris Street is a rare blend of heritage, light, and location an urban retreat that captures the essence of San Francisco living at its most refined. Walk score of 99.
